title: Skip Intro (Library of Ruina)
description: The Skip Intro exefs patch of Library-of-Ruina-NX-Mods (the author's personal patch), for Library of Ruina 1.0.3, and a host callback that lets a tap or key press of Touchscreen Mode end the auto-save notice before the AMV, which only the A button ends in the game.

launcher.label: Skip Intro
launcher.note: Automatically skips the AMV on startup. In Touchscreen Mode, tapping the screen skips the auto-save notice before it. Original mod by trilliance
